mapper.sql: c.comment_id, c.article_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.writer_user_id, c.writer_user_type, c.writer_name, c.content, c.secret_yn, c.like_count, c.report_count, c.depth, c.client_ip, c.status, c.delete_yn, c.created_by, c.created_ip, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_ip, c.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_bbs_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_comment p ON p.comment_id = c.parent_comment_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY COALESCE(p.created_at, c.created_at) ASC, COALESCE(p.comment_id, c.comment_id) ASC, c.depth ASC, c.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_bbs_comment WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N' AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT FROM tb_bbs_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_comment ( comment_id, article_id, parent_comment_id, writer_user_id, writer_user_type, writer_name, content, secret_yn, depth, client_ip, status, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{commentId}, #{articleId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{writerUserId}, #{writerUserType}, #{writerName}, #{content}, #{secretYn}, #{depth}, #{clientIp}, #{status}, #{deleteYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET content=#{content}, secret_yn=#{secretYn}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET delete_yn = 'Y', status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count + #{delta}, 0) WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET report_count = GREATEST(report_count + #{delta}, 0) WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET status = 'REPORTED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND delete_yn = 'N' AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT , a.title AS article_title, m.bbs_code AS bbs_code, m.bbs_name AS bbs_name, s.site_code AS site_code FROM tb_bbs_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_article a ON a.article_id = c.article_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = a.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id WHERE c.delete_yn = 'N' AND c.created_by = #{createdBy} AND c.status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_comment WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= #{cutoff}
